## For language changes

- [ ] Forms verified by a native/fluent speaker (say who, or that it is you)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` pass
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) — skip for docs-only or CI-only changes
- [ ] Public API changes are documented in TSDoc and, where relevant, in `docs/`
